words.ex_en: There seem to be so many rules and regulations these days.
words.ex_zh: 如今好像条条框框很多。

words.ex_en: a law that first came into being in 1912
words.ex_zh: 于1912年制定的一条法律

words.ex_en: He was always criticising his wife’s appearance.
words.ex_zh: 他老是批评妻子的外表。

words.zh: 推荐，介绍；劝告；使受欢迎；托付
words.ex_en: Doctors strongly recommend that fathers should be present at their baby’s birth.
words.ex_zh: 医生极力建议孩子出生时父亲应该在场。

words.zh: 思考的；思想的；有理性的；好思考的
words.ex_en: the thinking man’s pop band
words.ex_zh: 有思想的男士喜欢的流行乐队

words.ex_en: The current trend is towards more part-time employment.
words.ex_zh: 当前的趋势是雇用更多的兼职人员。

words.zh: 队，组；全体人员，全体船员
words.ex_en: The plane crashed, killing two of the crew and four passengers.
words.ex_zh: 飞机坠毁，造成两名机组人员和四名乘客死亡。

words.ex_en: a child with a hearing disability
words.ex_zh: 有听力障碍的儿童

words.ex_en: His work is truly original.
words.ex_zh: 他的作品确实十分独特。

words.ex_en: Cash was taken during a burglary of the apartment.
words.ex_zh: 在一次公寓盗窃案中现金被盗。

words.zh: 紧急情况；突发事件；非常时刻
words.ex_en: Lifeguards are trained to deal with emergencies.
words.ex_zh: 救生员接受过应对紧急情况的训练。

words.zh: 独特的，稀罕的；[数] 唯一的，独一无二的
words.ex_en: Each person’s fingerprints are unique.
words.ex_zh: 每个人的指纹都是独一无二的。

words.ex_en: water with a low salt content
words.ex_zh: 含盐量低的水

words.ex_en: a group of students selected at random
words.ex_zh: 随机挑选出来的一组学生

words.ex_en: We will keep your details on file (= store them for later use ) .
words.ex_zh: 我们将把你的详细资料存档。

words.ex_en: People who had heard the evidence at the trial were surprised at the outcome.
words.ex_zh: 在审判过程中听过证词的人都对此结果感到吃惊。

words.ex_en: She was always defending her husband in front of their daughter.
words.ex_zh: 她在女儿面前总是为丈夫辩解。

words.ex_en: All of us ought to go.
words.ex_zh: 我们大家都应该去。

words.ex_en: At least nine out of ten Mexicans are baptized Catholics.
words.ex_zh: 至少十分之九的墨西哥人是受过洗礼的天主教徒。

words.ex_en: Gorbachev failed to keep the component parts of the Soviet Union together.
words.ex_zh: 戈尔巴乔夫没能使苏联各组成部分保持在一起。
